scope: Bounded native ARM64 packaged Linux recovery, raw camera capture and persistent diagnostics

productionChanges: Linux logs rotate on startup or at 5 MiB, retaining three backups per publisher log family; concurrent publisher isolation retained. Windows/macOS logging unchanged.
Linux Secret Service failures log only fixed operation/stage/reason categories. No destinations, credentials, item references or server messages. Deadlines, prompts and preservation policy unchanged.
Portable packaging hashes the exact copied source snapshot, eliminating mismatched source archive/tree identities when the working tree changes during packaging.

package.note: Built from the recorded base revision plus changes captured exactly in the source archive. Later documentation/evidence files do not alter production sources.

gates.classification: Build, syntax, logic, linkage and source integrity gates only; not application testing.

hostWindowRecovery.scope:
Bounded packaged Linux GUI/media workflow, usable on ARM64 and amd64.

Run under linux-private-desktop.py on an owned Xvfb display. Uses the existing
Tk moving source, real GUI actions, a private PulseAudio server and independent
FFmpeg reception/decoding of loopback MPEG-TS. No host audio/device changes.
This is not physical desktop, hardware encoder, WebRTC or performance qualification.
